'''Ticket Master''' is an [[NPC]] located in various [[Locations]] around the [[Dwarven Mines]] that allows players to easily travel around the [[Dwarven Mines]] at a cost. The cost of the minecart ride is calculated by multiplying the distance to the destination by {{Gold|2x}}.

== Interface ==
{{/UI}}

== Dialogue ==
{| class="wikitable"
!Condition
!Random Dialogue
|-
| class="ct" rowspan="8" | Purchasing a Ride
|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &bTicket Master&f: Hop on in and I'll get you going!}}
|-
|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &bTicket Master&f: Hop in and we'll be off!}}
|-
|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &bTicket Master&f: See that empty, weak metal box? Good! That's your cart, hop in!}}
|-
|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &bTicket Master&f: Hold tight, it's going to be a bump ride!}}
|-
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &bTicket Master&f: Thanks for choosing Dwarven Mine Co. - we operate 24\/7 across the whole mine!
&e[NPC] &bTicket Master&f: Now, please climb aboard before your cart leaves without you.
&e[NPC] &bTicket Master&f: Again.
}}
|-
|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &bTicket Master&f: Let's a go!}}
|-
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &bTicket Master&f: Ever been in one of these before? No?
&e[NPC] &bTicket Master&f: Well...
&e[NPC] &bTicket Master&f: I'm sure you'll be fine!
}}
|-
|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &bTicket Master&f: Last guy who was in this cart didn't feel too well so watch out he might have left a surprise in there.}}
|-
| class="ct" | Missed [[Minecart]]
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &bTicket Master&f: Quickly now the Minecart is leaving!
&e[NPC] &bTicket Master&f: &cOh no! It looks like you missed the Minecart!
}}
|-
| class="ct" | Arriving
|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &bTicket Master&f: Welcome to the &3<location>&f!}}
|-
| rowspan="2" class="ct" | Traveling to [[Hanging Court]]
|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &bTicket Master&f: Off to the court? I would tell you to talk to the King but I don't know who he is anymore...}}
|-
|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &bTicket Master&f: Did you know the Court is almost as old as the throne room, it's got some lovely flower beds too!}}
|-
| class="ct" | Traveling to [[Gates to the Mines]]
|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &bTicket Master&f: See those statues? They are the former Kings, Bunumir Ironbeard and Skordous Pebblebeard, guarding the entrance to the mines.}}
|-
| class="ct" | Traveling to [[Aristocrat Passage]]
|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &bTicket Master&f: Aristocrat passage ey? Best of luck to you.}}
|-
| class="ct" | Traveling to [[Forge Basin]]
|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &bTicket Master&f: Did you know that the Forge is so big it has to have multiple forging stations.}}
|-
| class="ct" rowspan="2" | Traveling to [[Goblin Burrows]]
|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &bTicket Master&f: You ever seen those Goblins? Some say they lay eggs. How weird.}}
|-
|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &bTicket Master&f: Goblin's are not the only creatures that dwell here. Rumor has it dirt monsters linger in these parts too...}}
|-
| class="ct" rowspan="3" | None
|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &bTicket Master&f: I once stumbled upon a hidden lake in these parts, Some unsavory characters living there robbed me of all my gold!}}
|-
|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &bTicket Master&f: You came down the lift? I never thought you could get this far down! Someone should have called this place the Deeper Caverns!}}
|-
|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &bTicket Master&f: Hey, if you find any Titanium down here let me know! I wanted to buy some of that stuff for a new pickaxe.}}
|}

&e[NPC] &dEdelis&f: After we started learning magic centuries ago, most people stopped praying in the &5Cathedral&f.
&e[NPC] &dEdelis&f: They were too busy to learn and create new spells, and even turned the &5Cathedral &finto an Academy.
&e[NPC] &dEdelis&f: Those people will say that they believe in knowledge and magic.
&e[NPC] &dEdelis&f: Some others still believe that it was our prayers that gave us our powers.
&e[NPC] &dEdelis&f: They believe it was the Sky's plan to make us independent through &aSulphur&f, and that the Sky is good and fair.
&e[NPC] &dEdelis&f: And finally there are still very few people like me, who hold their faith in the &9Hero&f.
&e[NPC] &dEdelis&f: The Hero was humble, yet they saved us all from doom.
